rows.grounds: object of knowing; the principle described
demonstrative pointing to the stated truth
compound describing those characterized by bondage of existence

items.question: What effect does knowing this truth have on those constituted by worldly bondage?
premises: This truth can be directly known.
Some beings are constituted by the bondage of worldly existence.
The goddess is addressed as the recipient of this teaching.
items.inference: Knowing this truth bears directly on the condition of those constituted by worldly bondage.
uncertainties: The verse is fragmentary, so the specific result of knowing is not explicitly stated.
The referent of bhava+bandhā+tmakaiḥ could be beings or bonds depending on the missing continuation.
items.plain_english: O goddess, O beloved, having known this truth, by those constituted of the bondage of worldly existence...
